initialExam.title: BTET 2026 (Bihar TET)
initialExam.description: Bihar Teacher Eligibility Test for certification of teachers for primary and upper primary levels in Bihar state schools.
initialExam.qualifications: Teaching qualification as per NCTE norms
initialExam.syllabus: Paper I: Child Dev, Hindi, English/Urdu, Math, EVS. Paper II: Child Dev, Languages, Math/Science or Social Studies.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper I: 150 marks, 2.5 hrs. Paper II: 150 marks, 2.5 hrs.
initialExam.jobRole: Primary and Middle School Teacher in Bihar
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit bsebonline.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
